labels.title: Title
labels.select_values_before_generate: Please select at least one value for each option before generating.
labels.no_attributes_added: No attributes yet. Load a template or add attributes manually.
labels.no_attribute_values: This attribute has no predefined values.

is_published.active: When enabled, the product will be visible on the website.
is_published.inactive: When disabled, the product will only be visible in the admin panel.

is_default.active: When enabled, the variant will be selected as default in the website
is_default.inactive: When disabled, the variant will not be selected as default in the website.

status.in_stock: Active and available for purchase. Customers can see and buy this product.
status.out_of_stock: Visible on the storefront, but customers cannot add it to their cart. Used when inventory reaches zero.
status.inactive: Hidden from the storefront. Customers cannot see or buy this product, but it remains in your catalog.
status.discontinued: Permanently retired. This product is hidden, cannot be purchased, and will not be restocked.

help_texts.is_default: When enabled, this variant will be selected as the default option on the website.
help_texts.images: The first image is the featured photo. Use the arrows to change the order.
help_texts.attributes: Load attributes from a template, add them manually, or mix both — then remove what you don't need. Attributes left without a value are not saved.
